column1: 30651§conversely§ˈkɒnvɜːsli§adv. 相反地；反过来说；反之§Conversely, Pascal, used in software development and educational instruction, is not an object-oriented language.§**相反**，用于软件开发和教学编程的 Pascal 并不是面向对象的语言。§Conversely, Percnostola rufifrons (the black-headed antbird), with which T. surinamus shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging.§**相反**，Percnostola rufifrons（黑头蚁鸟）——T. surinamus 在法属圭亚那与它共享领地——采取叶片拾取式觅食（从叶上啄取昆虫），觅食时视野受到极大限制。§converse 相反的 → conversely§§用于引出对称的另一面§改译文2：原译把与 T. surinamus 共享领地误写成「与棕头蚁鸟共享」，并漏了学名

30652§simultaneous§ˌsɪmlˈteɪniəs§adj. 同时的；同时发生的§The bird species Tachyphonus surinamus (the fulvous-crested tanager) practices a foraging strategy known as sallying (catching insects in flight and returning to a perch to eat them), enabling it to scan for prey and predators simultaneously.§鸟类 Tachyphonus surinamus（黄冠唐纳雀）采用一种称为「突袭式觅食」的策略（在空中捕虫后返回栖枝进食），这使它能够**同时**搜寻猎物与天敌。§While these films effectively reduce heat gain and improve energy efficiency in buildings with large windows, they simultaneously decrease natural light transmission.§这些膜虽能有效减少热量增益、提升大窗建筑的能效，却也**同时**降低了自然采光。§§simultaneously adv. 同时地（scan for prey and predators simultaneously 同时搜寻猎物与天敌）§与 sequential（依次的）相对§

30653§watershed§ˈwɔːtəʃed§n. 流域；集水区；（引申）分水岭；转折点§The relative levels of fecal zoostanols (steroids with animal origins), such as coprostanol and epi-coprostanol, in layers of lake bed sediments at Buffalo Ford Lake in Yellowstone National Park show that bison, elk, or both have been the dominant ungulate species in the lake’s watershed for at least the last 2,000 years.§黄石国家公园布法罗福特湖湖底沉积层中，粪源动物甾醇（源自动物的类固醇，如粪甾醇与表粪甾醇）的相对含量表明，至少在过去两千年里，野牛、麋鹿或两者一直是该湖**流域**内的优势有蹄类物种。§Although fecal-steroidal profile alone is not sufficient to distinguish between samples from bison and those from elk, the relative levels of zoostanols (steroids with animal origins), such as coprostanol and 24-ethyl-coprostanol, in sediments at Buffalo Ford Lake in Yellowstone National Park show that bison, elk, or both were the predominant ungulates in the lake's watershed for all strata of sediment examined, going as far back as 2,300 years.§尽管仅凭粪便甾醇谱不足以区分野牛与麋鹿的粪样，但黄石国家公园布法罗福特湖沉积物中动物甾醇（源自动物的类固醇，如粪甾醇与 24-乙基粪甾醇）的相对水平表明：在所检测的全部沉积层（远至 2300 年前），野牛、麋鹿或两者一直是该湖**流域**占主导的有蹄类。§§the lake’s watershed 湖泊流域；a watershed moment 分水岭时刻；转折点§§改译文2：fecal-steroidal profile 原译成「粪甾醇」，Buffalo Ford Lake 误作「水牛湖」，并漏译括号说明

30654§prominence§ˈprɒmɪnəns§n. 突出；显著；显要；（山峰的）相对高度§But a summit's elevation may not be as good an indication of how high the mountain appears to observers as is the summit's prominence, or its height above its surroundings, and these values can differ significantly.§但一座山峰的海拔，未必比其「**相对高度**」（即峰顶高出周围地形的幅度）更能说明它在观察者眼中看起来有多高，而这两个数值可能相差很大。§The moon jar first gained prominence in Korea in the late seventeenth century.§月亮罐于 17 世纪晚期在朝鲜首次获得**显赫声名**。§§the summit’s prominence 峰顶的相对高度；come to prominence 崭露头角；gain prominence 声名鹊起§§

30655§invaluable§ɪnˈvæljuəbl§adj. 极宝贵的；无价的；价值无法估量的§The predictive model, which incorporates this algorithm, is sure to be invaluable in determining the optimal mix of a city's amenities.§纳入这一算法的预测模型，在确定一座城市设施的最佳组合时必定**极有价值**。§§§§be invaluable in doing 对做…极为宝贵§注意不是「无价值的」：in- 在此为强调，valuable 到无法计价§

30656§articulate§ɑːˈtɪkjuleɪt§v. 清晰表达；阐明 adj. 口齿清楚的；善于表达的§This phenomenon can be explained by the finite nature of cognitive capacity as it is articulated in Annie Lang's limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing.§这一现象可以用认知能力的有限性来解释，正如 Annie Lang 的「动机性媒介信息加工有限容量模型」所**阐述**的那样。§§§§as it is articulated in 正如…所阐述的；an articulate speaker 善于表达的演讲者§§

30657§reserve§rɪˈzɜːv§n. 矜持；沉默寡言；储备；储量；保护区 v. 保留；预订；留给§There was no hint of disapproval in her reserve; I merely felt in her an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him.§她的**沉默**里没有半点非难的意味；我只是感觉到，她心中有一道无法逾越的屏障，令她不愿谈及他。§Hawaiian home lands are areas of public land in the state of Hawaii that have been reserved for use by the Kanaka Maoli, or the Native Hawaiian people.§夏威夷家园地是夏威夷州为卡纳卡毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）**保留**使用的公有土地。§§foreign currency reserves 外汇储备；petroleum reserves 石油储量；an ample reserve of stored energy 充足的储能；be reserved for 专供；留给；Game Reserve / Nature Reserve （野生动物）保护区；reserved adj. 矜持的；寡言的（真题 3 次）；reservation n. 预订；保留意见（have reservations about）；（北美原住民）居留地（真题 8 次）§文学篇章中 reserve 指「矜持、寡言」（对应真题正确项 Constraint 克制）；reservoir（水库；储层）是近形异义词，勿混§改译文：删去夹在译文里的英文（reserve），译文2 同（reserved for）；删搭配：两条与本词无关的「同句」说明（722 emerging economies、548 insurmountable）

30658§seismic§ˈsaɪzmɪk§adj. 地震的；地震引起的；（引申）影响深远的；巨大的§Uisdean Nicholson and his team have discovered evidence in seismic data of a 40-kilometer-wide subsurface crater beneath nearly a kilometer of water off the coast of West Africa that is consistent with a 400-meter-wide asteroid striking the seafloor.§Uisdean Nicholson 及团队在西非近海近一千米深的水下，从**地震**数据中发现了证据：一个直径 40 公里的地下陨石坑，与一颗直径 400 米的小行星撞击海底的情形相符。§The Apollo Moon landings (1969–1972) left charged particle detectors and seismic sensors on the Moon and produced large amounts of data.§阿波罗登月计划（1969-1972）在月球上留下了带电粒子探测器和**地震**传感器，产出了海量数据。§§seismic data 地震数据；seismic shift 剧变；seismology n. 地震学§§

30659§canopy§ˈkænəpi§n. （森林的）树冠层；华盖；天篷；遮篷§While not everyone notices it, beneath the tree canopy of an ordinary city park lies an extraordinary web of life—fungus breaking down fallen leaves, native bees pollinating wildflowers, and moss growing in the crevices of an old log.§尽管并非人人都注意到，在一座普通城市公园的**树冠**之下，藏着一张非凡的生命之网——真菌分解落叶，本土蜜蜂为野花传粉，苔藓在旧木的缝隙里生长。§Toward noon it built up great canopies of white cloud that threw a cool shadow over fields and woods; then before sunset the clouds dissolved again, and the western light rained its unobstructed brightness on the valley.§近午时分，天空垒起巨大的白云**华盖**，在田野与树林上投下清凉的影子；日落前云又消散，西天的光便毫无遮拦地把明亮洒进山谷。§§beneath the tree canopy 在树冠之下；great canopies of white cloud 大片白色云盖§§

30660§expire§ɪkˈspaɪə§v. 到期；期满；失效；（文）断气；死亡§When a book's copyright expires, the book enters the public domain.§当一本书的版权**到期**，该书即进入公有领域。§§§§a copyright expires 版权到期；expiration date 有效期至§来自 ex-（出）+ spirare（呼吸），本义「呼出最后一口气」，引申为「死亡；期满」§原书错：辨析说 expire「与 exhale（呼气）无关」，其实 expire 词源义就是呼气（ex- + spirare）

30661§intuition§ˌɪntjuˈɪʃn§n. 直觉；直观；直觉力§If this intuition is correct and we lack an inviolable duty to speak truthfully, what grounds opposition to lying in the first place?§如果这一**直觉**是对的，而我们并没有必须说真话的绝对义务，那么反对说谎的依据究竟从何而来？§Posada's “My art is a journey through the invisible realm—a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.”§波萨达说：「我的艺术是一场穿越无形之境的旅程——在那里，**直觉**、记忆、幻象与梦，都可以自由地获得视觉形态。」§§§与 instinct（本能）不同：intuition 仍属认知层面，可被论证检验§

30662§replicate§ˈreplɪkeɪt§v. 复制；复现；重复（实验）§Buenos Aires has high pedestrian traffic, but simply replicating a feature of Buenos Aires associated with walkability—e.g., its high concentration of shaded streets—may be insufficient to induce increased walking in other cities.§布宜诺斯艾利斯的步行人流很大，但仅仅**复制**它与适宜步行相关的一项特征——例如其高密度的遮荫街道——或许不足以促使其它城市的人增加步行。§Leann Kanda, a researcher and sewing enthusiast, experimented with several techniques in her attempt to replicate the famous pleating of the Fortuny Delphos gown.§研究者兼缝纫爱好者 Leann Kanda 为**复现**著名的福图尼德尔斐袍褶裥，尝试了多种技法。§§replication n. 重复验证§科研语境指「重复实验」§

30663§carve§kɑːv§v. 雕刻；刻；（引申）开创；开拓§Relief printing is a technique in which an image is carved onto a printing block, covered in ink or paint, and stamped onto paper.§凸版印刷是一种把图像**刻在**印版上、涂上油墨或颜料、再压印到纸上的技法。§In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls.§在每周他最爱的一小时美术课上，他用回形针在陶杯陶碗的底部**刻下**自己的名字。§§be carved onto 被刻在…上；carve out a niche 开创一席之地；carving n. 雕刻；雕刻品§§删搭配：原搭配说明「carving — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数」不是搭配，改为 carving 的释义

30664§intricate§ˈɪntrɪkət§adj. 错综复杂的；精细复杂的；精巧的§Inventories of excavation sites from the Alazani River valley and nearby areas dating from 4000 to 500 BCE show a steep drop occurring around 1500 BCE in the number of objects featuring gold filigree, an advanced technique in which fine threads of gold are arranged in intricate patterns.§阿拉扎尼河谷及邻近地区公元前 4000 至 500 年的发掘遗址清单显示，公元前 1500 年左右，带金丝细工（一种把细金丝排成**繁复**纹样的高级工艺）的器物数量急剧下降。§The ghazal, a poetic form originating in seventh-century Arabic poetry, has an intricate structure.§加扎勒——源于七世纪阿拉伯诗歌的诗体——结构**繁复**。§§intricate patterns 繁复的纹样；intricacy n. 错综复杂§褒义偏多，强调精巧§

30665§turbulence§ˈtɜːbjələns§n. 湍流；紊流；（社会、政治）动荡；（飞行）颠簸§Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for medium-sized vortices, fish with wide heads would be least able to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water.§Liao 用三种头型的模型（窄头、中等头、宽头，按宽长比划分）表明，对中等尺寸的涡而言，宽头鱼最难以区分水中的涡与一般**湍流**。§§§§general turbulence 一般湍流；political turbulence 政治动荡；turbulent adj. 湍急的；动荡的§§

30666§acquaintance§əˈkweɪntəns§n. 相识；熟人；了解§Yung Wing was the first American college graduate of Chinese heritage; Phoebe Brown was the first prominent female hymn writer in the United States. I look back upon my acquaintance with Mrs.§容闳是第一位华裔美国大学毕业生；Phoebe Brown 是美国第一位知名的女赞美诗作者。我回顾自己与……夫人的**相识**……§Miguel was hoping not only to meet us but to make the acquaintance of the poet himself at Mamá's house.§米格尔不仅盼着见到我们，还盼着在妈妈家与诗人本人**结识**。§§acquaintance with 与…相识；对…的了解；make one’s acquaintance / make the acquaintance of 结识某人§比 friend 疏远§改译文：原译漏译前两句（Yung Wing、Phoebe Brown）

30667§lush§lʌʃ§adj. 茂盛的；葱郁的；（色彩、声音）浓郁丰富的§Harold Newton’s Yellow Day, a wetland landscape with palm trees and lush greenery set against the pastel yellows and pinks of the sky and water, is typical of paintings by the mid-twentieth-century landscape artists now known as the Florida Highwaymen.§Harold Newton 的《黄色的一天》描绘了一片湿地风景：棕榈树与**葱郁**的草木映衬着天空与水面淡雅的黄色和粉色，是 20 世纪中叶那批如今被称为「佛罗里达公路客」的风景画家的典型作品。§For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo has also been called "the Land of Green Fields," a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the lush greenery that surrounds it.§再如，波多黎各的哈蒂约市也被称为「绿野之地」——这个别名暗指该地闻名之处：环绕四周的**葱茏**绿意。§§lush tropical forests 茂密的热带森林；lush greenery 葱郁的草木§§改译文：原译是另一句（「公路客」画派塑造佛罗里达公众印象），按英文重译

30668§longevity§lɒnˈdʒevəti§n. 长寿；寿命；持久性§In 1879, in an effort to determine the longevity of certain seeds left in soil, botanist William Beal buried 20 glass bottles filled with sand and seeds from a variety of plants, including Verbascum, Amaranthus retroflexus, and Stellaria media.§1879 年，为测定留在土壤中某些种子的**寿命**，植物学家 William Beal 埋下 20 只玻璃瓶，瓶中装有沙土以及毛蕊花、反枝苋、繁缕等多种植物的种子。§Researchers studying solar cell longevity use mathematical models to predict operational lifespans under normal conditions.§研究太阳能电池**寿命**的研究者用数学模型预测其在常规条件下的运行寿命。§§the longevity of certain seeds 某些种子的寿命§与 long 同源，比 long life 更正式§

30669§induce§ɪnˈdjuːs§v. 引起；诱发；诱导；劝诱§In tomato plants, herbivory induces defensive production of jasmonic acid, while microbial infection induces defensive production of salicylic acid; plants also emit airborne chemicals to initiate the appropriate defense in nearby tomato plants.§在番茄植株中，植食作用会**诱导**防御性茉莉酸的生成，而微生物感染则诱导防御性水杨酸的生成；植株还会释放经空气传播的化学物质，以启动附近番茄植株的相应防御。§Thai slow-cinema director Apichatpong Weerasethakul (Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives) even states that his own work induces sleep in audiences.§泰国慢电影导演阿彼察邦（《能召回前世的布米叔叔》）甚至表示，他自己的作品会**诱使**观众入眠。§§induce sleep 催人入睡；sleep-inducing 引人入睡的；inducement n. 诱因§与 cause 相比更偏「诱导出某种生理、心理反应」§改译文：原译是另一段（阿彼察邦电影令人入睡），按英文重译；改译文2：「催」改为「诱使」，便于标出 induces

30670§contend§kənˈtend§v. 主张；声称；争夺；竞争；（contend with）应对；对付§Philosophers espousing presentism (the view that only present things exist) must contend with the truth-maker objection (TO).§信奉「现在主义」（认为只有当下的事物才存在）的哲学家，必须**应对**「真理制造者」异议（truth-maker objection，TO）。§§§§contend that 主张…；contend with 应对；对付；contention n. 论点；争执§比 argue 更带「与人争辩」的意味§改例句：句末多一个「 .」；改译文：the view that only present things exist 原译成「只有当下存在的事物为真」

30671§endeavor§ɪnˈdevə§n. 努力；尝试；（艰巨的）事业 v. 努力；力图§This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors.§这种定性有其用处，但在作品如何被看待方面也带来弊端——毕竟在艺术**事业**中，创造力与想象力被赋予了很高的价值。§§§§artistic endeavors 艺术事业；endeavor to do 努力做§比 attempt 更正式、更有分量§

30672§indicative§ɪnˈdɪkətɪv§adj. 表明的；指示的；象征的§Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as politely addressing the audience, extensive use of simple rhyming (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.§Wade 举出文本中**表明**现场表演的特征，例如礼貌地称呼观众、大量使用易于记诵的简单押韵，以及向听众索要赏钱。§§§§be indicative of 表明；是…的迹象；indicator n. 指标§be indicative of 而非 indicative to§

30673§ambiguous§æmˈbɪɡjuəs§adj. 模棱两可的；含糊的；不明确的§It is also unclear whether categorizing music by genre is useful, since genre categories are ambiguous, subjective, and simplistic.§按类型为音乐分类是否有用也仍不清楚，因为类型划分本身**模糊**、主观而且过于简化。§But his conflict with Sempringham Priory must be seen as an indirect result of a legally ambiguous property dispute involving land on which his manor sat: he was taking property that he seems to have sincerely believed was rightfully his.§但他与塞普林厄姆修道院的冲突，须视为一场法律归属**含糊**的地产纠纷的间接结果：他取走的，似乎是他真心相信本属于自己的产业。§§§与 ambivalent（态度矛盾的）区分：前者指意义不明，后者指心里两难§

30674§adhere§ədˈhɪə§v. 黏附；附着；坚持；遵守§The team used three separate extraction methods: an ultrapure water rinse, a rinse combined with ultrasonic waves, and an alkaline solution treatment that removes epicuticular wax (a surface coating on most land plants to which particles can adhere).§团队采用了三种分离提取方法：超纯水冲洗、超声波辅助冲洗，以及去除上表皮蜡质的碱性溶液处理——上表皮蜡质是多数陆生植物表面的涂层，颗粒可以**附着**其上。§Wenhao Xu and colleagues demonstrated that applying a low direct current electrical field to graphite (a conductor) and an acrylamide (AAm) gel can increase how strongly materials adhere to each other.§Wenhao Xu 及同事证明：对石墨（导体）与丙烯酰胺凝胶施加低强度直流电场，可增强材料之间的**黏合**。§§adhere to 黏附于；坚持；遵守（adhere to a rule）；adhesion n. 黏附§§

30675§venom§ˈvenəm§n. （蛇、蝎等的）毒液；恶毒；怨恨§Scientists recently tested whether scorpion venom reduces the growth of bacteria.§科学家最近检验了**蝎毒**是否能抑制细菌的生长。§The statement “all tarantulas are venomous” is scientific because it could be proved false by a single observation to the contrary, according to Karl Popper.§按照卡尔·波普尔的观点，「所有狼蛛都**有毒**」这一陈述是科学的，因为一次相反的观察即可将其证伪。§§scorpion venom 蝎毒；speak with venom 恶毒地说；venomous adj. 有毒的§§

30679§constituent§kənˈstɪtjuənt§n. 成分；组成部分；选民 adj. 组成的；构成的§The ratio of methane to other atmospheric constituents—represented by a measure called the methane mole fraction—influences a variety of meteorological phenomena, notably precipitation and humidity.§甲烷与其它大气**成分**的比例——用一种称为「甲烷摩尔分数」的量来表示——会影响多种气象现象，尤其是降水与湿度。§Direct contact with constituents via such means as public events and emails from voters is a major source of politicians’ beliefs about their constituents’ views, but it is susceptible to a selection effect.§通过公开活动和**选民**来信等方式与选民直接接触，是政客了解选民观点的主要渠道，但它容易受选择效应影响。§§atmospheric constituents 大气成分；constituents 选区选民§§原书错：义项把名词义「选民（constituents）」放在形容词下

30680§aesthetics§iːsˈθetɪks§n. 美学；审美；审美观§The ancient Greek concept of “mimesis,” a term used in the works of Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers in discussions of representational art—visual, performance, or literary art that aims to depict the real world—is a foundational concept of the Western philosophy of aesthetics.§古希腊的「摹仿」（mimesis）概念——柏拉图、亚里士多德等希腊哲学家在讨论再现性艺术（旨在描绘现实世界的视觉、表演或文学艺术）时使用的术语——是西方**美学**哲学的基础概念。§They argue that aesthetics often outweigh fidelity to the past among designers for shows with historical settings.§他们主张：在设计历史题材剧集的布景时，**美学**考量常常压倒对历史的忠实。§§the philosophy of aesthetics 美学哲学；aesthetic adj. 审美的§§

30683§humility§hjuːˈmɪləti§n. 谦逊；谦卑§Some psychologists such as Elena Park are conducting projects that are meant to foster intellectual humility (the ability to realize that one is wrong and to publicly admit it) among scientific researchers.§一些心理学家（如 Elena Park）正在开展项目，意在培养科研人员的智识**谦逊**（即意识到自己可能出错，并公开承认这一点）。§Jia Hu and colleagues hypothesized that workplace leaders who reflect on lessons learned from past mistakes are likely to exhibit more humility than leaders who don't engage in such reflection.§Jia Hu 及同事假设：会反思过往错误教训的职场领导者，比不做这种反思的领导者表现出更多**谦逊**。§§intellectual humility 智识上的谦逊§humility 是美德，humiliation 是羞辱，二者不可混用§
